overview: The Mustang Report featured updates on a recent snowstorm, the progress of a student hydroponics project, and promotions for upcoming school events.

items.title: Opening Sketch
items.summary: Victoria Rasche searches for various team members throughout the school to assemble the Mustang Report crew.

items.title: Weather Report
items.summary: Amber Harbison reported on a recent snowstorm that dropped approximately 13 inches of snow and interviewed others about winter activities.

items.title: Question of the Week
items.summary: The answer to the previous week was revealed as 'Two', and a new question was posed regarding a date in 2001.

items.title: Hydroponics Project Update
items.summary: An update was provided on a Medford Education Foundation grant-funded hydroponics system that uses fish to help grow edible plants.

items.title: Breaking Science Announcement
items.summary: Victoria Rasche promoted a new science program scheduled for April 12th in the science lecture hall.

items.title: Drama Club: Fiddler on the Roof
items.summary: Drama Club president Marcus Mazzotti discussed the themes and performance schedule for the upcoming production of Fiddler on the Roof.
